notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 5, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
